SELECT r.*, f.student_name AS studentName, f.student_id AS studentId, f.location AS location FROM first_visit_result r LEFT JOIN first_visit f ON r.first_visit_id = f.id WHERE f.visitor_id = #{visitorId}
AND f.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentName}, '%')
SELECT r.*, f.student_name AS studentName, f.student_id AS studentId, f.location AS location FROM first_visit_result r LEFT JOIN first_visit f ON r.first_visit_id = f.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.id AS id, r.first_visit_id AS firstVisitId, r.crisis_level AS crisisLevel, r.problem_type AS problemType, r.conclusion AS conclusion, f.location AS location, f.student_name AS studentName, f.student_id AS studentId FROM first_visit_result r LEFT JOIN first_visit f ON r.first_visit_id = f.id WHERE r.conclusion = '安排咨询' AND f.status = '已完成' ORDER BY f.is_emergency DESC, f.is_alert DESC, r.id DESC
